summary: Adventure shell translated: 1 name (frozen), 1 description (1,782→1,406 chars), 7 folder names (3 frozen + 4 translated), 4 macro names. Key verifications done from source rather than from the brief: (1) re-derived the folder freeze from DO-NOT-TRANSLATE.json §folder_names — exactly 3 entries: Alien Tables / Alien Creature Tables / Alien Mother Tables, all emitted byte-identical; (2) independently confirmed `Alien Sub-Tables` is translatable — its only occurrence in the system tree is systems/alienrpg/module/apps/migratefolders.js:29, and that file's sole importer is COMMENTED OUT at init.mjs:2 (`// import migrateFolders from './migratefolders.js';`), matching the register's `dead-source-files` defect note; the pack dump also shows it is a child of `Alien Mother Tables`, and Folder#contents being non-recursive means it never reaches the creature-sheet dropdown either way. Translated it to 异形子表 (the glossary's own adopted value). (3) `Alien Macros`, `Careers`, `Skill-Stunts` have zero live-code references (only a commented-out `// await deleteFolderIfExist("Skill-Stunts")` at init.mjs:89), so all three translated. (4) Verified the 4 macro `command` fields to see which folder literals they hard-code (Mother/Creature macros only) and which ALIENRPG.* keys their dialogs use, then matched the macro NAMES to those dialog strings. Output carries no `command` key. Description register is plain instructional Chinese, second person 你; every sheet/field label was looked up in lang/cn.json rather than paraphrased.

open_issues:
UPSTREAM TYPO, corrected deliberately — the English description says the Journal Entry is "MO/TH/ER Instructions" (letter O, no trailing period). The actual document is 'MU/TH/ER Instructions.' (letter U, WITH trailing period), per register §name_lookups id=system.welcomeJournalEntry, and it stays frozen English in the Chinese pack. I wrote the real name, following the register's own precedent in upstream_defects id=textdraw-label-typo: 'The label is display-only, so translate it to match the TABLE, not the typo.' If the controller wants the typo propagated instead, change 4 characters in the one

.

Macro name vs. its own dialog title, for the Creature roller. The two macros are parallel in English ('Roll on selected Mother/Creature table V10'), but the phase-1 lang values they pop are NOT parallel: ALIENRPG.ROLLONSELECTED='在选定的老妈表格上投骰' vs ALIENRPG.ROLLONCREATURETABLE='抽取异形生物表'. I kept the two macro NAMES parallel (在选定的老妈表格上投骰 / 在选定的生物表格上投骰), so the Creature macro's name and its dialog title differ in wording. The alternative — naming it 异形 - 抽取异形生物表 V10 — matches the dialog but breaks the pair. Controller's call; it is a name-only change, no code touches either string.

The <h1> is T-BILINGUAL ('异形RPG系统 Alien RPG System') while the Adventure `name` field beside it in the compendium browser stays frozen English. That is intentional — different fields, only `name` is compared with ===. If the controller prefers the h1 to mirror the sidebar exactly, revert the h1 text to bare English; the explicit id is harmless either way and should stay.

Link-label tier is mixed on purpose: the six official-module purchase links got T-BILINGUAL labels (中文 + one ASCII space + English) because a Chinese buyer lands on an English store page and needs the English title; the first label, 'Free League - Alien RPG', was left fully English because both halves are brand strings and a bilingual form would duplicate 异形RPG. Flagging in case the controller wants uniformity.

Whitespace fidelity: I preserved every ASCII space that sits adjacent to a tag in the English (e.g. '…ENNIE 奖。

', '…录进来：
', '
'), including the ones that now follow a full-width Chinese punctuation mark and look stray. They are invisible in render but a whitespace-normalising QA pass would strip them and cause a false diff against the English structure.

Latin-spacing convention applied, for cross-unit consistency: ASCII spaces around standalone Latin in running prose (Foundry VTT 上, 由 Free League 出品, 曾获 ENNIE 奖, 定制 3D 骰子) but fused with no space inside established title compounds (异形RPG, 异形RPG新手包). Phase-1 lang/cn.json is itself split on this (仅限GM and Ctrl+单击 fused vs 输入 D66 点数 and 恐慌表 Panic Table spaced), so this is my reading, not a lock. If the controller sets a project-wide rule, this unit has 6 affected spots.
